name: KOOZO
short: A Belgian brand born from a personal ambition to make original, timeless design furniture accessible: clean lines, high comfort and a considered production process.
long:
KOOZO is a Belgian brand founded on a simple, personal ambition: to give design lovers the chance to own original, timeless furniture within reach. Every collection balances an enduring aesthetic with everyday comfort, made possible by a carefully considered production process.

Developed in collaboration with its designers, the pieces are authentic, functional and built to last, with a calm, clean presence that settles naturally into a space and stays there for years.
